messages:
zoe-events: Quick heads-up — vendor (BrightPress) flagged a swag qty mismatch for the Northeast LLM Salon. They say 650 polos shipped but our order was 450. Need a plan for bulk adjustments + courier ETA by EOD tomorrow.

maria-marketing: yikes. where did we get 650 from? I checked the request form, it says 450.

jamal-growth: can we hold extras for post-event lead outreach? extra shirts could be useful for followups/partners.

eli-ops: I pinged BrightPress — tracking shows 2 pallets (pkgs 37 & 38) currently in transit to our NYC warehouse. ETA: Wed 10:30am. I asked them to confirm packing list and if they can reroute one pallet back to vendor.

karen-design: if we keep extras, we should reserve a dozen in brand-safe sizes for execs and press. Also need new hang tags printed with updated QR for the lead form (version v3).

sam-sales: Heads-up — we already submitted 6 speaker gift allocations to ops. Can we confirm whether gifts are affected by the extra pallet?

zoe-events: @eli-ops can you paste the tracking #s and whether courier can hold at dock? If they can hold, we can recheck counts before acceptance.

eli-ops: tracking: UPS#1Z999AA10123456784 (pkg 37), UPS#1Z999AA10123456785 (pkg 38). BrightPress says they can hold one pallet at their fulfillment center until we confirm by Tue 5pm. If we accept both, we need additional storage at the venue — cost ~ $120/day for crate space.

maria-marketing: Proposed plan: 1) ask BrightPress to hold 1 pallet (the extra) 2) accept the correct pallet at NYC warehouse 3) do quick QC Wed morning (spot check 30 shirts) 4) finalize counts and decide by Thu AM whether to 1) ship extras to venue as backup or 2) return to vendor. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jamal-growth: +1. also, if extras exist we can use 100 as demo/test giveaways at the afterparty table. less waste.

karen-design: sizes breakdown we ordered: S 15, M 120, L 180, XL 85, XXL 50. If the extra pallet matches distribution we'll be fine. If it's bulk L only, we should flag returns.

sam-sales: Can someone add the speaker gifts list to the same shipment manifest? We need to know if the 6 gifts are in pallet 37 or 38. If not, we'll need to courier them separately (same-day courier ~ $75 within city).

eli-ops: confirmed with BrightPress: speaker gifts were packed in pkg 37. So if we hold pkg 38 they're safe. BrightPress also sent a packing list PDF: https://brightpress.example.com/packs/2030/packinglist.pdf

deliveries-bot: [package-scanned] UPS#1Z999AA10123456784 scanned into NYC WH at 09:12 UTC.

zoe-events: ok great. action items: @eli-ops ask BrightPress to hold pallet 38 until Tue 17:00. @maria-marketing coordinate hang tag v3 files with design and send to print by Tue noon. @karen-design reserve 12 exec sizes from accepted pallet. @sam-sales confirm speaker gifts still boxed and labelled. I'll update the runbook.

maria-marketing: printing note: vendor for hang tags is ReproNYC — lead time 48 hrs for 1k tags. I'm going to send them files now.

eli-ops: request to BrightPress sent. They confirmed hold for pallet 38 and will not ship without written approval. Also reserved dock slot Wed 08:30 for inbound inspection.

jamal-growth: for lead routing flow — if we get extras and deploy them at afterparty, route leads into SFDC queue: marketing-trials > jamal-growth as owner. Otherwise route to events-inbound for follow-up.

sam-sales: noted. I'll add a CRM tag: "NE-LLMSalon-2026" and set automated owner based on event touchpoint.

karen-design: small checklist for ops team to QC on Wed: ```- count 5 random boxes from inbound pallet
- verify sizes match PO breakdown
- confirm speaker gifts (6) boxed and labelled
- collect product photos for social (3 angles)
- set aside exec sizes (12)
```

zoe-events: PR/bench narrative: if we end up with extras we can spin a small social push about "overflow excitement" and use the extra for community meetups. But prioritize reducing returns.

maria-marketing: I'll draft two social captions: one for normal launch and one cheeky overflow angle. Will share by Tue 2pm for review.

eli-ops: final note — if we accept both pallets, venue crate storage doubles cost to $240/day. Budget owners FYI @maria-marketing @jamal-growth.

zoe-events: thanks all. I'll update the runbook and ping again after QC Wed. :white_check_mark:
